📡 通过RSS订阅岛の碎碎念

一颗叛逃轨道漂浮在宇宙中的小岛，正在记录银河系漫游指南✧ʕ̢̣̣̣̣̩̩̩̩·͡˔·ོɁ̡̣̣̣̣̩̩̩̩✦☄︎

你好呀，人类。或者..外星人？无论你来自哪里，为什么来，我都相信这是宇宙在暗中安排的奇妙邂逅。我们在某个时空的某一个坐标交汇，本身就是概率近乎为零的奇迹。很高兴遇见你，愿你的每一天都温暖、明亮，健康。我呢，是这颗蓝色星球中既普通又特别的一个，一团凝结成了会思考的形状的小小星尘，拥有人类这种生物常见的小毛病：缺乏耐心、易燃易爆炸，普通却自信；同时也有些不太常见的特质：超强的共情力、多愁善感，以及，还算善良（至少我是这样希望的^^）

如果你需要用标签来拼凑出一个模糊的我，那大概会找到这样的一些碎片。当然，如果你不想在真正接触我之前，就被这些僵硬的词汇预先框住想象，完全可以选择不点开它们。毕竟刻板印象总是乏味的。但若是你实在好奇，欢迎来玩刮刮乐：

  • 女权主义者
  • 测了至少50遍都是ENFP的水瓶座
  • 正在执着地收集Pusheen相关的一切产品
  • 可以连续一个月三餐只吃炒土豆丝和爆辣新疆炒米粉
  • 非常非常非常喜欢J·M·库切，周杰伦和林宥嘉
  • 恐怖片爱好者，尤其是cult和slasher
  • 吃任何东西都要蘸醋

不过呢，用标签去定义一个人，终究还是太简单粗暴了。就像无法用几次潮汐概括整片海洋，我们也很难用几个关键词还原一个完整的人。生命的色彩要来得丰富太多、复杂太多。好在这里存放着一些我的想法，我就在这些文字的背后，请随意翻阅。只是，这些文字也并非全部的我。它们不过是我在某个瞬间的定格，好比水面映出的月亮不是真正的月亮，我也是不断流动、变化着的。当下的表达就只代表敲下键盘那一刻的我，不代表此时此刻，更不代表明天的我。

在这个什么都很快，快到来不及细看一次花开的时代，人与人的羁绊似乎也变浅了。我们和很多人一起吃饭玩耍，却很少有人会认真问一句"你最近在想什么？"，更少有人愿意耐心听完答案。我们默契地停留在安全的表面，成为彼此最熟悉的陌生人。而我呢，我总是很好奇，你怎么看这个世界？你怎么理解人生、存在，以及那些说不清道不明的东西？我们不必思考相同的问题，甚至可以拥有截然相反的答案。重要的是你在表达，而我在倾听。毕竟从思想开始慢慢地靠近一个人，是件奢侈又浪漫的事，你觉得呢？

如果你愿意停留几分钟，给予我的表达一点点回应的话，那就太好啦。我始终相信生命与生命之间那些柔软的连结，比如真诚、友善、理解，它们比偏见和仇恨要珍贵得多。看见和被看见，大概就是我表达的全部意义了。

无论如何，谢谢你读到这里！

Click here to expand for the English translation

A runaway island floating in space, currently recording its own Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Galaxy. ✧ʕ̢̣̣̣̣̩̩̩̩·͡˔·ོɁ̡̣̣̣̣̩̩̩̩✦☄︎

Hello there, human. Or… alien? Wherever you are from and whatever brings you here, I’d like to believe this is a wondrous encounter quietly orchestrated by the universe. The fact that we cross paths at this specific coordinate in time and space is a miracle with a near-zero probability. I’m so glad to meet you. May your days be warm, bright, and full of health.

As for me? I’m just an ordinary yet unique soul on this blue planet, a tiny clump of stardust that happened to condense into a thinking shape. I come with the usual flaws of being human: lacking patience, being a bit short-tempered, and possessing that typical, unearned confidence. But I also have a few less-common traits: deep empathy, a sentimental heart, and a pretty kind soul (at least, I’d like to think so ^^)

If you need tags to piece together a blurry silhouette of who I am, you’d probably find these fragments:

  • Feminist
  • ENFP/Aquarius
  • Devoted Pusheen collector
  • A horror movie enthusiast

But then again, defining someone with tags is always a bit too reductionist, like trying to summarize the entire ocean by a few tides. The colors of life are far richer and more complex. Fortunately, this space holds some of my thoughts, and I am right here behind these words. Feel free to browse. However, these words are merely snapshots of me at a single moment. Just as the moon reflected in the water is not the real moon, I am constantly flowing and changing. What I express here only represents who I was the second my fingers hit the keyboard, not who I am right now, and certainly not who I will be tomorrow.

In an era where everything moves so fast, too fast to even watch a flower bloom, human connections seem to have grown thin. We eat and hang out with so many people, yet rarely does anyone genuinely ask, “What’s been on your mind lately?” and even fewer are willing to listen to the answer with patience. We tacitly stay on the safe surface, becoming each other’s most familiar strangers.

But me? I’m always curious. How do you view this world? How do you make sense of life, existence, and all those fleeting, inexplicable things? We don’t have to ponder the same questions, and we can even hold polar opposite answers. What matters is that you are expressing, and I am listening. After all, getting to know someone slowly, starting from their mind, is a rare and romantic luxury, don’t you think?

If you’d like to stay for a few minutes and leave a little echo to my thoughts, that would be wonderful. I’ve always believed in the tender connections between souls, like sincerity, kindness, and understanding. They are far more precious than prejudice and hatred. To see and to be seen; I suppose that is the entire meaning of my expression.

In any case, thank you for reading this far!

Really. ♡
